skills.name: anuran-dev
skills.description: When to use this: reach for anuran.dev when you need Anuran Roy's public posts, projects, papers, or read-only JSON API (listPosts, listProjects, listPapers, getHealth, getMeta). Use when asked about Anuran Roy's writing, code, research, or site API. How to call: GET https://anuran.dev/api/v1/posts?limit=5, /projects, /papers, /meta (no auth) or npx -y anuran-dev --help. Do not use for auth, billing, private data, or writes.
